native.scope: Focused native CPU and grouped Vulkan checks after the isolated build.
argv:
import json,subprocess,time
from pathlib import Path
out=Path('/out');cases=[]
for mode in ('cpu','vulkan'):
 argv=['/build/llmx-low-bits-test']+(['--vulkan'] if mode=='vulkan' else [])
 started=time.time()
 with (out/(mode+'.stdout')).open('xb') as stdout,(out/(mode+'.stderr')).open('xb') as stderr:
  r=subprocess.run(argv,stdout=stdout,stderr=stderr,timeout=60)
 cases.append({'mode':mode,'argv':argv,'exit_code':r.returncode,'seconds':time.time()-started})
 (out/'cases.json').write_text(json.dumps(cases,indent=2)+'\n')
 assert r.returncode==0,mode
assert 'mixed and homogeneous groups: exact dispatch and same-projection-alone bits [ok]' in (out/'vulkan.stdout').read_text()
